title: DispatchSuite pricing for contractors
snippet: Scheduling, CRM, reporting, and invoicing software for contractors. Plans start at $129 per month per user.

title: Why are we still copying data between tools?
snippet: Our small business uses a spreadsheet plus text messages and a scheduling app. We manually re-enter every estimate into accounting; errors cost us hours each week.

title: Three tools for one completed job
snippet: Field workers copy and paste from the CRM to email and accounting because mobile sync fails. The duplicate entry is too expensive for a two-person company.

title: Feature request: unofficial webhook integration
snippet: A missing integration and no API forces repeated exports and imports between scheduling and inventory.

title: New regulation requires portable digital job records
snippet: Beginning in 2026, licensed mobile trade businesses must retain digital job records under the new recordkeeping rule.

title: LegacySync shut down after infrastructure costs blocked adoption
snippet: The startup failed in 2019 because its integration technology and cloud infrastructure were too expensive for the small market.

title: New API makes local-first event bridges available
snippet: A new API and cheaper edge hardware now support local event automation and webhooks without a centralized database.

title: Open-source workflow bridges see repository growth
snippet: Open-source event bridge projects and GitHub repositories are gaining stars as mobile-first field teams request integration automation.
